summary: Tested new Share Kit (poster/QR/captions), Refer & Earn QR + invite message, strict IFSC/UPI validation (Profile + Admin edit), and Admin KYC copy icons. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed. Frontend: all critical share-kit and copy flows verified. No blocker bugs found; only minor observations.
critical_code_review_comments: ShareKit useBlobUrl doesn't surface load errors — if /api/share/poster fails (e.g. auth expired) the spinner stays forever with no user feedback. Consider showing a fallback/retry.

ReferEarnCard uses window.location.origin/signup?ref=CODE for the invite link, but ShareKit poster QR encodes /api/go/<slug>?ref=CODE (server-derived origin from request Origin header). These two link shapes are inconsistent; verify Origin header is set by ingress in production so tracked link resolves.

In server.py _validate_kyc, error message reads 'Invalid IFSC code (e.g. HDFC0001234)'. Frontend expects prefix 'Invalid IFSC code' — matches, but for consistency with the spec ('Invalid IFSC code') consider trimming the example from the response detail or exposing structured errors.
AdminKyc detail modal hides copy-aadhaar when aadhaar is empty (fine), but consumers must not assume the button always exists — currently OK because our review only requires it for stored values.
seed_data_creation: None. Test Customer's original IFSC (HDFC0009999) and UPI (testcust@ybl) were restored in-page (only client-side edits, no PUT with invalid values persisted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend save button in CustomerEditDialog is data-testid=cust-edit-kyc-save (not cust-edit-save). Admin login form uses admin-email/admin-password/admin-submit testids. Grant clipboard-read/clipboard-write context permissions before testing copy-to-clipboard. /api/auth/login returns {token, user} not {access_token}. Frontend Refer & Earn message pre-element contains the emoji-prefixed message; the surrounding refer-message-preview div also has a header — assert on the <pre> content, not full div text.

frontend.kyc_ifsc_auto_uppercase_and_short_error: PASS (typing 'hdfc12' -> value 'HDFC12', error 'IFSC must be 11 characters (6/11 entered) — e.g. HDFC0001234')
frontend.kyc_upi_error_for_abc: PASS ('Invalid UPI ID. Format: name@bank (e.g. rahul@upi)')
frontend.admin_detail_modal_copy_icons: PASS (pan, holder, account, ifsc, upi, ref present; aadhaar hidden when empty)
